Full Circle Discharge.name: Full Circle Discharge
Full Circle Discharge.description: The user's signature move: the user releases their maximum safe charge in a broad circle across a large room. Every uninsulated person caught inside takes heavy electric damage and is stunned until the end of their next turn; held back, the user stops after the stun. Allies are equally vulnerable, and the release leaves the user's thoughts scrambled until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
